target: When she reached him, El said, "O merciful stranger. You seem to be from my homeland, but there is no need to risk yourself for me alone. Leave me, and save your precious life."
notes: Western Lowen Korean with Chinese support. 보석을 주신 is verbal gave, not High God; generic God/Heaven retained. SP-7 source spelling differs from PS-7 elsewhere and is preserved. Este 로데 source typo normalized to established Este Daudet. Morglay provisional.

original: 아웬은 대답을 해 주고 싶었지만, 목소리가 나오지 않았습니다. 그녀는 말 없이 그의 쇠사슬을 푸는데 열중했지요. 하지만, 엘을 묶은 쇠사슬은 너무나 단단해서 아웬으로서도 풀 방법이 없었답니다.
chinese_reference: 阿雯很想回答，却已经发不出声音。她只是默默地试着解开他的锁链。可是，束缚艾尔的锁链太过坚固，她怎么也解不开。
target: Awen wanted to answer, but no voice came. Silently, she struggled to free him from his chains. But they were so strong that even she could find no way to undo them.
notes: Western Lowen Korean with Chinese support. 보석을 주신 is verbal gave, not High God; generic God/Heaven retained. SP-7 source spelling differs from PS-7 elsewhere and is preserved. Este 로데 source typo normalized to established Este Daudet. Morglay provisional.

original: 아웬은 아래쪽에서 적군이 사다리를 놓고 올라오고 있는 것을 보았습니다. 그녀는 다급해졌습니다. 이윽고, 아웬은 엘의 팔에 칼을 갖다 대었어요. 그의 팔을 자르지 않고서는 묶은 쇠사슬을 풀 방법이 없었기 때문이지요.
chinese_reference: 阿雯看到下方的敌人架起梯子，开始往上爬，心中越发焦急。终于，她把刀抵在了艾尔的手臂上。因为不砍断他的手臂，就没有办法将他从锁链中解脱出来。
target: Awen saw the enemy putting up a ladder and climbing toward them. Desperate, she placed her blade against El's arm. There was no way to free him from the chains without cutting it off.
notes: Western Lowen Korean with Chinese support. 보석을 주신 is verbal gave, not High God; generic God/Heaven retained. SP-7 source spelling differs from PS-7 elsewhere and is preserved. Este 로데 source typo normalized to established Este Daudet. Morglay provisional.

original: 엘은 고개를 끄떡였습니다. "자르십시오. 그것 밖에는 방법이 없는 것 같군요." 아웬은 눈물을 머금고 엘의 팔을 잘랐답니다. 엘은 자신의 팔이 잘리자 그 충격으로 기절했지요.
chinese_reference: 艾尔点了点头。“砍吧。看来只能这样了。”阿雯含着泪，砍下了艾尔的手臂。艾尔随即因断臂的剧痛昏了过去。
target: El nodded. "Cut it off. There seems to be no other way." With tears in her eyes, Awen severed his arm. The shock made El lose consciousness.
notes: Western Lowen Korean with Chinese support. 보석을 주신 is verbal gave, not High God; generic God/Heaven retained. SP-7 source spelling differs from PS-7 elsewhere and is preserved. Este 로데 source typo normalized to established Este Daudet. Morglay provisional.

original: 아웬은 엘을 사슬에서 풀기는 했지만, 내려갈 곳이 없었지요. 더군다나 적들은 사다리를 놓고 절벽을 올라오고 있었어요. 아웬은 다시한번 하늘에 빌어야만 했지요.
chinese_reference: 阿雯虽然救出了艾尔，却无路可下。而敌人正顺着梯子爬上悬崖。她不得不再一次向天空祈求。
target: Awen had freed El, but there was no way down. The enemy was climbing the cliff by ladder. Once again, she had to pray to the heavens.
notes: Western Lowen Korean with Chinese support. 보석을 주신 is verbal gave, not High God; generic God/Heaven retained. SP-7 source spelling differs from PS-7 elsewhere and is preserved. Este 로데 source typo normalized to established Este Daudet. Morglay provisional.

original: '하늘이여, 나의 자비로운 하늘이여! 이 보석을 그에게 주겠습니다. 처음에 제 소원을 들어주셨던 대로 그를 지켜주십시오. 그리고 제 목숨을 드리겠습니다. 그러니 이번엔 그를 이곳에서 빠져 나갈 수 있게 해주세요.'
chinese_reference: “上天啊，仁慈的上天！我要把这颗宝石交给他。请像最初答应我的愿望那样，保护他。我愿献出自己的生命。这一次，请让他逃离这里。”
target: "Heaven, merciful Heaven! I will give him this gem. Protect him, as you promised when you first granted my wish. And I offer you my life. This time, please let him escape this place."
notes: Western Lowen Korean with Chinese support. 보석을 주신 is verbal gave, not High God; generic God/Heaven retained. SP-7 source spelling differs from PS-7 elsewhere and is preserved. Este 로데 source typo normalized to established Este Daudet. Morglay provisional.

original: 그리고 그녀는 보석을 엘의 가슴에 놓고 절벽으로 달려가 뛰어내렸습니다! 그녀가 뛰어내리는 순간에 엘은 자신의 가슴에 놓인 차가운 보석의 감촉 때문에 눈을 떳지요.
chinese_reference: 说完，她把宝石放在艾尔胸口，跑向悬崖，纵身跃下！就在她跳下的瞬间，艾尔被胸前宝石冰冷的触感惊醒了。
target: She placed the gem on El's chest, ran to the cliff, and leaped! As she fell, the cold touch of the gem on his chest woke El.
notes: Western Lowen Korean with Chinese support. 보석을 주신 is verbal gave, not High God; generic God/Heaven retained. SP-7 source spelling differs from PS-7 elsewhere and is preserved. Este 로데 source typo normalized to established Este Daudet. Morglay provisional.

original: 그 순간 엘은 보았습니다, 아웬의 머리띠가 풀리면서 그녀의 찬란한 아침햇살같은 머리가, 하얀 아침안개 같은 피부를, 그가 꿈속에서도 그리워하던 아웬이 자신을 위해 목숨을 내놓으려는 장면을... 그는 소리쳤지요. "아웬!" 하지만 아웬은 대답없이 아래로, 아래로 떨어져갈 뿐이었습니다.
chinese_reference: 那一刻，艾尔看见她的发带散开，露出如晨光般灿烂的秀发，以及如晨雾般白皙的肌肤，看见那个连梦中都令他思念的阿雯，正要为他献出生命……他喊道：“阿雯！”可阿雯没有回答，只是一再向下，向下坠落。
target: At that moment, El saw Awen's headband come undone, revealing hair radiant as morning sunlight and skin white as morning mist. Awen, whom he had longed for even in his dreams, was giving her life for him... "Awen!" he cried. But she gave no answer, only fell farther and farther below.
notes: Western Lowen Korean with Chinese support. 보석을 주신 is verbal gave, not High God; generic God/Heaven retained. SP-7 source spelling differs from PS-7 elsewhere and is preserved. Este 로데 source typo normalized to established Este Daudet. Morglay provisional.

original: 그때, 그곳에 있던 모든 사람들은 신의 말을 들었답니다. "그대의 엘을 향한 마음은 잘 알겠다. 나는 그대의 목숨을 거두어 들이고, 새 생명으로 화할 것이니 그대는 엘을 구하도록 하라."
chinese_reference: 那时，在场的所有人都听到了神的声音。“我已明白你对艾尔的心意。我将收下你的生命，让你化为新的生灵。去吧，救下艾尔。”
target: Then everyone there heard God's voice. "I understand your love for El. I will take your life and give you a new form. Go and save him."
notes: Western Lowen Korean with Chinese support. 보석을 주신 is verbal gave, not High God; generic God/Heaven retained. SP-7 source spelling differs from PS-7 elsewhere and is preserved. Este 로데 source typo normalized to established Este Daudet. Morglay provisional.

original: 엘은 자신의 가슴에 놓인 보석이 눈을 뜨지 못할 정도로 강렬히 빛나는 것을 보았습니다. 그리고 그가 다시 눈을 뜨자, 그의 앞에는 못보던 거대한 새 한마리가 있었죠.
chinese_reference: 艾尔看见胸前的宝石放出耀眼的光芒，刺得他睁不开眼。等他再次睁开双眼，面前出现了一只从未见过的巨鸟。
target: El saw the gem on his chest shine so brightly that he had to close his eyes. When he opened them again, an enormous bird unlike any he'd seen stood before him.
notes: Western Lowen Korean with Chinese support. 보석을 주신 is verbal gave, not High God; generic God/Heaven retained. SP-7 source spelling differs from PS-7 elsewhere and is preserved. Este 로데 source typo normalized to established Este Daudet. Morglay provisional.

original: 엘은 그 새의 눈을 응시하면서 말했답니다. "아웬, 아웬. 당신이요?" 새는 대답이라도 하듯이 몸을 앞으로 내밀었습니다. 엘은 그 새의 등에 탔고, 새는 하늘을 날았습니다!
chinese_reference: 艾尔凝视着鸟的眼睛，说道：“阿雯，阿雯。是你吗？”鸟仿佛在回答他，俯下了身子。艾尔爬上鸟背，巨鸟便飞向天空！
target: El gazed into the bird's eyes. "Awen, Awen. Is it you?" As if answering, the bird leaned forward. El climbed onto its back, and it took to the sky!
notes: Western Lowen Korean with Chinese support. 보석을 주신 is verbal gave, not High God; generic God/Heaven retained. SP-7 source spelling differs from PS-7 elsewhere and is preserved. Este 로데 source typo normalized to established Este Daudet. Morglay provisional.

original: 엘의 고향 사람들은 엘이 한 팔이 없는 채로 돌아온 것도 놀랐지만, 엘이 이상한 새 한마리와 같이 온 것이 더 놀라웠습니다. 엘은 돌아온 이후로 말이 없어지고, 외진곳에 오두막을 짓고 새와 같이 살면서 돌 세공하는데 열중했지요.
chinese_reference: 故乡的人们看见艾尔失去了一条手臂，已经十分吃惊，可他还带着一只陌生的鸟回来，更让他们惊讶。回来后，艾尔变得沉默寡言，在偏僻的地方盖了一间小屋，和鸟一起生活，终日埋头雕琢石头。
target: The people of El's homeland were shocked to see him return without an arm, but more astonished by the strange bird beside him. El grew quiet after his return. He built a secluded hut, lived there with the bird, and devoted himself to carving stone.
notes: Western Lowen Korean with Chinese support. 보석을 주신 is verbal gave, not High God; generic God/Heaven retained. SP-7 source spelling differs from PS-7 elsewhere and is preserved. Este 로데 source typo normalized to established Este Daudet. Morglay provisional.

original: 엘은 평생에 걸쳐서 그의 가슴속에 놓였던 보석을 재생하는데 힘을 쏟았고, 이윽고 전혀 새로운 보석을 개발해 내었지요. 그것이 카오스큐브 인 것이에요. 그리고 엘이 자신의 고향으로 돌아온 이후로, 엘을 구한 새와같은 용맹하고 거대한 새가 전국에서 보이게 되었지요. 사람들은 그 새를 매라고 부른답니다.
chinese_reference: 艾尔耗费一生，试图重现当年放在胸口的那颗宝石，终于创造出一种全新的宝石。那就是混沌方块。而自从艾尔回到故乡，那种与救过他的鸟一样勇猛、巨大的鸟，也开始出现在全国各地。人们把它们叫作隼。
target: El spent his life trying to recreate the gem that had rested on his chest, eventually creating an entirely new jewel: the Chaos Cube. After his return home, enormous, valiant birds like the one that saved him began appearing throughout the country. People call them falcons.
notes: Western Lowen Korean with Chinese support. 보석을 주신 is verbal gave, not High God; generic God/Heaven retained. SP-7 source spelling differs from PS-7 elsewhere and is preserved. Este 로데 source typo normalized to established Este Daudet. Morglay provisional.

chinese_reference: 怎么样，故事有趣吗？辛苦您听了这么长的故事，我给您一份奖励吧。

Despite its name, the forest is easy to cross if you simply head straight north toward Bordeaux. Turn east toward the demon sword, though, and you'll enter a very confusing part of the forest...

chinese_reference: [剑术研究会]/n从前，我们研究会里有个叫帕兹的人。他本人也是个出色的剑士，甚至有“疾速的帕兹”这样的称号……

chinese_reference: [剑术研究会成员]/n你听说过潘德拉根的制式剑吗？听说SP-7“闪电”非常出色……足以称得上量产型圣剑。
